answer: Make every voice collateralized. An identity must lock earned coin as a bond before its writing counts, and a rotating jury compares submissions for overlap. A farmer who clones one text across many keys loses the umber deposit on every clone the jury flags, so the payoff flips negative: the delta between minting cost and slashed bond widens with each fake. Influence becomes an island you reach by paying your own way, not a crowd of fresh keys.
